text.text_excerpt: First off. On Thursdays Tradition at my job is Hanks Seafood Potatoe. When i tell you the best potatoes full of seafood goodness. Its I believe 14$ but it is well worth the price.I was so full and content. It is inside the bar so you will see people partying sometimes in the daylight. There's always music while you wait. Time will be spent because everyone cones to crap these potatoes. So again you will be waiting for your food I mean but its still worth the wait. It cones with crawfish tails,shrimp,Lumps of crabmeat and topped off with green onion!! I can not write the goodness of this potatoe! Just try for yourself!

I chose the first Thursday night of the new year to try the seafood stuffed potato that I've heard so much about. Don't bother calling to order, because they won't answer the phone (personal experience and the guy who took my order confirmed). Don't let the lack of phone service keep you from the best seafood stuffed baked potato in town. Hop in your car and pull up to the side door. The super friendly order taker will walk up to your car window, take your order and payment, while you relax in the comfort of your vehicle. (This is surely a Covid precautionary measure, but it works!). After a few minutes my food was delivered to my car, by another very friendly gentleman (perhaps Hank, him...
Neighborhood bar in the Treme area. Always great food. People are nice and like to have fun. Very laid back atmosphere. If you are ever in the area, drop in.
